map.选择机构类型（四杆/凸轮/齿轮），输入参数计算运动特性与几何尺寸: Select the mechanism type (four-bar/cam/gear) and enter the parameters to compute the kinematics and geometry
map.💡 四杆：Grashof条件(最短+最长≤其余和)；传动角 cosγ=(b²+c: 💡 Four-bar: Grashof condition (shortest + longest ≤ sum of the others); transmission angle cosγ=(b²+c²-(d±a)²)/(2bc)
map.四杆机构：满足 Grashof 条件且最短杆为连架杆时存在曲柄: Four-bar mechanism: a crank exists when the Grashof condition is met and the shortest link is a side link
map.传动角越小传力性能越差，一般要求最小传动角 ≥ 40°（高速时≥50°）: The smaller the transmission angle, the worse the force transmission; the minimum transmission angle is usually required to be ≥40° (≥50° at high speed)
map.凸轮机构：推程角越大压力角越小，基圆越大压力角越小: Cam mechanism: the larger the rise angle, the smaller the pressure angle, and the larger the base circle, the smaller the pressure angle
map.齿轮机构：标准安装中心距 a=m(z1+z2)/2: Gear mechanism: standard installation center distance a=m(z1+z2)/2
map.📚 深度解析：齿轮/连杆/凸轮机构: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Gear / Linkage / Cam Mechanisms
map.齿轮中心距 a=m(z1+z2)/2、传动比 i=z2/z1。: Gear center distance a=m(z1+z2)/2, transmission ratio i=z2/z1.
map.四杆机构存在条件（杆长和定理）。: Existence condition of a four-bar mechanism (link-length sum theorem).
map.凸轮基圆半径与最大压力角校核。: Base circle radius and maximum pressure angle check of a cam.
map.最短+最长 ≤ 其余两杆和（Grashof 定理）方可整周回转；否则为双摇杆。如: The shortest + longest ≤ the sum of the other two links (Grashof theorem) is required for full rotation; otherwise it is a double rocker. For example 20+100≤40+60=100, equality holds, so it is marginal.
map.中心距为何等于两分度圆半径和？: Why does the center distance equal the sum of the two pitch radii?
map.标准安装时分度圆相切，节圆=分度圆，故 a=(d1+d2)/2=m(z1+z2): In standard installation the pitch circles are tangent and the operating pitch circle equals the reference pitch circle, so a=(d1+d2)/2=m(z1+z2)/2.
map.压力角越大越好？: Is a larger pressure angle better?
map.不是。压力角大传力好但效率低、易自锁；标准取 20°，小轮受限时校核最大压力角。: No. A large pressure angle transmits force well but lowers efficiency and tends to self-lock; the standard is 20°, and the maximum pressure angle should be checked when the pinion is constrained.
